id.description: One entry's ID from a list result. Returns that entry with its full Markdown text; the other arguments are ignored.

audience.description: Only entries for this audience: artists, developers or worker operators.

product.description: Only entries for this product ID, such as create, chat, api, sdk-js, sdk-python, mcp or fast-worker. Each entry lists its product IDs.

since.description: Only entries published at or after this time: an ISO 8601 date (read as midnight UTC) or a date-time with a zone.

until.description: Only entries published before this time: an ISO 8601 date (read as midnight UTC) or a date-time with a zone.

action_required.description: true lists only entries you need to act on, such as a model retirement or a new minimum worker version. false applies no filter.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Keep the same filters.
